 "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam nodesep 80
skinparam ranksep 90
skinparam Padding 6

' Deixa as linhas e bordas mais escuras e nítidas no draw.io
skinparam ArrowColor #222222
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.6
skinparam ArrowFontColor #111111
skinparam ArrowFontSize 12
skinparam ClassBorderColor #222222
skinparam ClassBorderThickness 1.5

' Destaque visual para Services, Hot Spots e Instâncias do Framework
skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor<<service>> #E2F0D9
 BorderColor<<service>> #548235
 BackgroundColor<<hot spot>> #FFF3CD
 BorderColor<<hot spot>> #D39E00
 BackgroundColor<<instance>> #E8F4FD
 BorderColor<<instance>> #2E75B6
}

package \"insights.application (Frozen Spot)\" {

 class DailyInsightsService <<service>> {
 - storeCatalog : StoreCatalog
 - salesHistory : ConfirmedSalesHistory
 - productCatalog : ProductCatalog
 - recipeCatalog : RecipeCatalog
 - stockSnapshot : StockSnapshot
 - demandForecastStrategy : DemandForecastStrategy
 - criticalLotActionStrategy : CriticalLotActionStrategy
 - defaultHorizonDays : int
 + getDailyInsights(date : LocalDate, expiryWindowDays : Integer, horizonDays : Integer) : DailyInsightsOutput [Template Method]
 - build(storeId : Long, storeName : String, date : LocalDate, ...) : DailyInsightsOutput [Polimorfismo -> DemandForecastStrategy & CriticalLotActionStrategy]
 }
}

package \"insights.domain (Core & Hot Spots)\" {

 package \"ports (catálogos e consultas)\" {
 interface StoreCatalog {
 + getDefaultStore() : Optional<StoreRef>
 }

 interface ProductCatalog {
 + findActiveProducts() : List<CatalogProduct>
 }

 interface ConfirmedSalesHistory {
 + findDailyQuantities(from : LocalDateTime, to : LocalDateTime) : List<DailySoldQuantity>
 }

 interface RecipeCatalog {
 + findAll() : List<RecipeLine>
 }

 interface StockSnapshot {
 + findActiveItems() : List<StockItemSnapshot>
 + findOpenLots() : List<StockLotSnapshot>
 }
 }

 package \"model (snapshots de leitura)\" {
 class CatalogProduct <<record>> {
 + id : Long
 + name : String
 + price : BigDecimal
 }

 class DailySoldQuantity <<record>> {
 + date : LocalDate
 + productId : Long
 + quantity : int
 }

 class RecipeLine <<record>> {
 + productId : Long
 + stockItemId : Long
 + quantityPerUnit : int
 }

 class StockItemSnapshot <<record>> {
 + id : Long
 + name : String
 + unit : String
 + currentQuantity : int
 + minimumStock : int
 }

 class StockLotSnapshot <<record>> {
 + lotId : Long
 + stockItemId : Long
 + quantity : int
 + expiresAt : LocalDate
 }
 }

 package \"strategies (Hot Spot 3) & core calculators\" {
 interface DemandForecastStrategy <<hot spot>> {
 + forecast(products : List<CatalogProduct>, history : List<DailySoldQuantity>, targetDate : LocalDate) : List<ProductDemand>
 }

 enum ForecastConfidence {
 HIGH
 MEDIUM
 LOW
 }

 class PurchaseSuggestionCalculator <<domain service>> {
 + {static} suggest(demand : List<ProductDemand>, recipes : List<RecipeLine>, items : List<StockItemSnapshot>, horizonDays : int) : List<PurchaseSuggestion>
 }

 class CriticalStockCalculator <<domain service>> {
 + {static} find(items : List<StockItemSnapshot>, recipes : List<RecipeLine>) : List<CriticalStock>
 }

 interface CriticalLotActionStrategy <<hot spot>> {
 + evaluateExpiringLots(lots : List<StockLotSnapshot>, items : List<StockItemSnapshot>, recipes : List<RecipeLine>, demand : List<ProductDemand>, targetDate : LocalDate) : List<InventoryAction>
 }

 DemandForecastStrategy -right-> ForecastConfidence : classifica >
 ForecastConfidence -[hidden]right-> PurchaseSuggestionCalculator
 PurchaseSuggestionCalculator -[hidden]right-> CriticalStockCalculator
 CriticalStockCalculator -[hidden]right-> CriticalLotActionStrategy
 }
}

package \"instances.insights (Especializações do Hot Spot 3)\" {

 class BurgerDemandForecastStrategy <<instance>> {
 + forecast(...) : List<ProductDemand>
 --
 Regra: Média por dia da semana (últimas 8 semanas)
 }

 class PharmaDemandForecastStrategy <<instance>> {
 + forecast(...) : List<ProductDemand>
 --
 Regra: Média móvel contínua (últimos 30 dias)
 }

 class PcBuilderDemandForecastStrategy <<instance>> {
 + forecast(...) : List<ProductDemand>
 --
 Regra: Projeção baseada em Lead Time de fornecedores
 }

 class BurgerPromotionActionStrategy <<instance>> {
 + evaluateExpiringLots(...) : List<InventoryAction>
 --
 Regra: Sugere promoção no cardápio (vencendo <= 3 dias)
 }

 class PharmaQuarantineActionStrategy <<instance>> {
 + evaluateExpiringLots(...) : List<InventoryAction>
 --
 Regra: Alerta de Quarentena e Descarte Sanitário
 }

 class PcBuilderBundleActionStrategy <<instance>> {
 + evaluateExpiringLots(...) : List<InventoryAction>
 --
 Regra: Sugere Kits/Bundles de Upgrade (Aging Stock > 90d)
 }

 BurgerDemandForecastStrategy .up.|> DemandForecastStrategy
 PharmaDemandForecastStrategy .up.|> DemandForecastStrategy
 PcBuilderDemandForecastStrategy .up.|> DemandForecastStrategy

 BurgerPromotionActionStrategy .up.|> CriticalLotActionStrategy
 PharmaQuarantineActionStrategy .up.|> CriticalLotActionStrategy
 PcBuilderBundleActionStrategy .up.|> CriticalLotActionStrategy

 BurgerDemandForecastStrategy -[hidden]right-> PharmaDemandForecastStrategy
 PharmaDemandForecastStrategy -[hidden]right-> PcBuilderDemandForecastStrategy
 PcBuilderDemandForecastStrategy -[hidden]right-> BurgerPromotionActionStrategy
 BurgerPromotionActionStrategy -[hidden]right-> PharmaQuarantineActionStrategy
 PharmaQuarantineActionStrategy -[hidden]right-> PcBuilderBundleActionStrategy
}

' Relacionamentos Application -> Ports
DailyInsightsService -down-> StoreCatalog
DailyInsightsService -down-> ProductCatalog
DailyInsightsService -down-> ConfirmedSalesHistory
DailyInsightsService -down-> RecipeCatalog
DailyInsightsService -down-> StockSnapshot

' Relacionamentos diretos e alinhados verticalmente Ports -> Snapshots
ProductCatalog -down-> CatalogProduct : retorna >
ConfirmedSalesHistory -down-> DailySoldQuantity : retorna >
RecipeCatalog -down-> RecipeLine : retorna >
StockSnapshot -down-> StockItemSnapshot : retorna >
StockSnapshot -down-> StockLotSnapshot : retorna >

' Alinhamento vertical das Strategies e Calculators abaixo dos Snapshots sem cruzar linhas
CatalogProduct -[hidden]down-> DemandForecastStrategy
DailySoldQuantity -[hidden]down-> PurchaseSuggestionCalculator
RecipeLine -[hidden]down-> CriticalStockCalculator
StockLotSnapshot -[hidden]down-> CriticalLotActionStrategy
